description: This file defines a HomeController class that manages the state and interactions for a home feed in a Flutter application. It handles loading, refreshing, caching, and error states related to content fetched from a ContentRepository.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier that manages the state of the home feed, including loading, refreshing, and error handling, with cache listening capabilities.

methods.name: HomeController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository and sets up a cache listener to refresh data when cache updates occur.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the home feed data from the repository, updating state and handling errors accordingly.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Triggers a reload of the home feed, typically called when cache updates are detected.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes the cache listener and performs cleanup.
